files.author: SharonPapierdreams
files.caption:
John and Anna O'Sullivan Farmstead
Directly adjacent to the stone barn on the south side, east of the drive-thru bay, is a wood framed granary with a shallow-pitched shed roof with metal corrugated roofing sloping south away from the barn.

files.title: File:John and Anna O’Sullivan Farmstead Douglas Co KS granary and stone barn ruin east facade.jpg
files.author: SharonPapierdreams
files.caption:
John and Anna O'Sullivan Farmstead
This is a Primary Farm Structure constructed circa 1880. The granary is 20-feet east-west by 16-feet north- south. It has a door in the west wall close to the barn, and a window opening in the south wall and in the east wall, each with a hinged panel door.

files.title: File:John and Anna O’Sullivan Farmstead Douglas Co KS granary and stone barn ruin looking northwest.jpg
files.author: SharonPapierdreams
files.caption:
John and Anna O'Sullivan Farmstead
The floor is wood framed and elevated off the ground on round timber piers. The siding is vertical boards nailed to horizontal wood girts; the siding is deteriorated at the bottom.
